title: Control-plane / node quota desynchronization causing tenant warmup deadlocks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Several customers reported sustained 429s during traffic warmups after rapid rollouts. Symptoms: new or scaled tenants show immediate rejections for several minutes despite available pool capacity, followed by abrupt throughput restoration. Initial triage shows this occurs in Hosted and Dedicated when hybrid routing is enabled and when quota refreshes coincide with control-plane leader elections. This ticket captures the investigation, short-term mitigations, and the long-term fix to prevent asymmetric quota enforcement between the control-plane and per-node admission agents.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure tenant with hybrid routing enabled and a low initial burst allowance
2) Rapidly scale the tenant from 0 to 50 concurrent streams (simulated load)
3) Trigger a control-plane leader rotate (kill leader process) while load increases
4) Observe that node admission agents continue to deny tokens despite control-plane reporting increased quota availability
5) Reproduce across Hosted and Dedicated with mixed region routing to see race frequency increase
impact_summary: High customer impact: multiple paying customers experienced 3-10 minutes of effectively unavailable inference during warmups. Affecting both Hosted and Dedicated tiers; caused escalations to Support and Account teams. Production SLO breaches for per-tenant P99 latencies during incidents; revenue-impacting for high-throughput tenants.
root_cause: A race between quota ledger epoch advancement in the control-plane and the admission agent's local epoch cache eviction. After leader election, the control-plane increments epoch and publishes a compacted ledger; however, some admission agents were honoring an older epoch due to a serialization bug in the pubsub deserializer. This led to admission agents believing tenants had exhausted burst credits and entering a defensive deny state even though the control-plane accepted new allocations. The hybrid routing path exacerbates the window because requests are routed to nodes with stale caches while the control-plane moved quota buckets to newly advertised shards.
mitigation: 1) Immediately increased quota broadcast frequency during leader change to force agent refreshes for impacted customers. 2) Rolled out a temporary admission-agent fallback to query control-plane synchronously if a tenant experienced >10 consecutive denies within 30s. 3) Added an alert for 'node_denies > 50% in 5m while control-plane reports positive balance' so SRE can respond quickly.
solution_notes: Primary fix: correct pubsub deserialization to preserve epoch markers and add a safe reconciliation handshake where admission agents will accept a single optimistic refresh message after leader election without requiring full ledger sync. Also add an idempotent reconciliation endpoint on control-plane that returns compacted ledger + epoch signature. Introduce a sliding-window logic in admission agents to avoid entering a hard deny state during ledger staleness (soft-deny with retriable backoff). Ensure unit tests cover leader rotation timing and multi-region routing behavior.
rollout_plan: Alpha deploy admission-agent patch (node-side): canary 5% of nodes in us-west-2
If canary stable for 30m with no increase in rejects, expand to 50% across region and monitor 'node_denies' and 'control_plane_balance_mismatch' alerts
Deploy control-plane reconciliation endpoint in a canary pair; validate compacted ledger shape and signature checks
Full rollout coordinated with SRE and Account teams; schedule 2-minute maintenance window note for Dedicated customers with private control-planes
Post-rollout: keep synchronous fallback enabled for 24 hours then remove fallback once metrics stable
qa_plan: Add integration test that simulates leader kill during high ramp and asserts <1% rejects during warmup
Create a load test that routes 10k short-lived streams across hybrid routing to measure deny spikes
Manual verification steps for SRE including stepping through leader rotation and examining agent epoch caches
Regression tests for pubsub serializer/deserializer with corrupted/compressed messages
postmortem_actions: 1) Publish incident timeline and notify affected customers with root cause and remediation steps
2) Add cross-team on-call runbook for quota-desync patterns and leader-rotation fragile points
3) Instrument epoch propagation timing metrics and add dashboards
4) Backfill unit and integration tests to cover the failure mode
5) Schedule a retro with Networking and Orchestrator teams to review hybrid routing assumptions
customer_communication: Initial triage message posted to Support thread #INC-2026-0310
Customer-facing status updated: 'Partial disruption during scaling; mitigation applied; engineering investigation ongoing'
